title: UMH Projection Capability Matrix Cell
description: One cell of the projection x capability matrix assembled from workstreams E1 (EOS, CreatorOS, LyfeOS — see E1 F6), E2 (operator experience/Jarvis-class incl. workstation, meta IDE incl. SaaS-dev skill system, node mesh execution), and E3 (BroadcastOS, Conference Rooms, ManufacturingOS, RoboticsOS, SecurityOS). The status enum is the union of the two vocabularies actually used in the ledgers: the E1/E2 substrate-maturity vocabulary (canonical-and-tested .. unclear-source-of-truth, n/a) and the E3 evidence-tier vocabulary (shipped-code .. inferred-only, stub-only).

projection.description: Matrix column: the projection/surface the cell describes. operator_experience covers the Jarvis-class workstation surface (E2 F1/F2); meta_ide covers the engineering surface including the SaaS-dev skill system; node_mesh covers cross-device execution.

status.description: Cell status. E1/E2 vocabulary: canonical-and-tested, present-but-fragmented, projection-specific-only, dormant, missing, untested, unclear-source-of-truth, n/a. E3 vocabulary: shipped-code (runtime evidence in repo), stub-only (endpoint/flag exists, no implementation), doc-spec-only (specified, not built), strategy-intent-only (strategy docs only), inferred-only (zero repo evidence; capability inferred).

substrate_owner_files.description: Repo-relative paths of the substrate/adapter/transport files that own (or would own) this capability, e.g. 'substrate/sockets/approval_port.py', 'adapters/broadcast/engine.py:103-199'.

source_refs.description: Evidence references backing the status: ledger id + path:line citations (e.g. 'E1 F6 row 4; data/repos/entrepreneuros/shared/schema.ts:376-423').

gap_or_packet_ref.description: Gap id (GAP-...) or work packet id (WP-...) that addresses this cell; null when the cell needs no action (canonical-and-tested, n/a).

notes.description: Optional qualifier (e.g. 'agent path not wired at boot', 'handler complete but never registered').
